about_the_game:
About this Demo The Fifth Bell – Demo Version invites you to a mysterious fog-covered village where an ancient legend comes to life.

In this version, you won’t experience the main campaign — it’s a separate map created specifically to introduce you to the game’s mechanics and atmosphere. In the demo you can expect: Exploration of a secluded area where several mystical offerings are hidden, similar in spirit to those found in the full version. An atmosphere of solitude and unsettling sounds. A chance to experience the core gameplay — exploration, item collection, and encounters with small pursuers — but without the story chapters from the full game.

Not included: The main story. All game chapters — the demo only represents a small fragment and serves as an introduction. The full set of mechanics, events, and enemies featured in the complete version. About the full game ---The full version of The Fifth Bell is an atmospheric mystical horror inspired by an ancient legend. You will explore a foggy village and nearby town, search for five hidden offerings, and survive the tolling of the bell — with each chime, the Reaper draws closer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) / AMD R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for stable performance. For the best experience, use headphones.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: An SSD and headphones are strongly recommended for full immersion.

short_description: The Fifth Bell — Demo A short demo of this atmospheric mystical horror game: try out the first fragment of the game and soak up its atmosphere. The demo gives an idea of ​​the visual style, sounds, and core mechanics; these elements will be expanded in the full release.
